claims.claim: In England, you can get an older person’s bus pass when you reach State Pension age.
claims.quote: In England you can get a bus pass for free travel when you reach the State Pension age .
claims.note: The older person’s pass page states the England State Pension age rule.

claims.claim: An eligible disabled person may qualify for a separate disabled person’s bus pass.
claims.quote: You’re eligible for a disabled person’s pass if you live in England and are ‘eligible disabled’.
claims.note: The separate disabled person’s pass page states the eligibility rule for England.
